These synthetic TrueType fixtures are authored for Reel's font selection tests.
Each contains .notdef, space, and one rectangular A glyph; all share the
"Reel Weight Fixture" typographic family. Weight 400/600/700 uses an A advance
of 500/650/800 units and a stem width of 100/180/260 units at 1000 units per em.
The glyph outlines and naming data are original project test data under the
workspace license. FontTools 4.60.1 FontBuilder serialized the three fonts.
